name: vibe-coding-designer
description: Design implementation-ready software specifications, workflows, test plans, prompts, and repository development packages without assuming a Web GUI.

interface.shortDescription: Design GUI or non-GUI software before implementation.
interface.longDescription: Guides product discovery and produces implementation-ready general-software specifications, data and workflow contracts, implementation prompts, traceable tests, reviews, and agent-neutral repository development packages. Web UI rules are applied only when needed.
defaultPrompt: Help me design a software product from an idea.
Create an implementation-ready specification without assuming a Web GUI.
Review my software design and produce a traceable test plan.
